data.description: List of available UMA Providers using Grid

hasMore.description: Indicates if more results are available beyond this page

nextCursor.description: Cursor to retrieve the next page of results (only present if hasMore is true)

totalCount.description: Total number of transactions matching the criteria (excluding pagination)

code.description: Three-letter currency code (ISO 4217) for fiat currencies. Some cryptocurrencies may use their own ticker symbols (e.g. "BTC" for Bitcoin, "USDC" for USDC, etc.)

decimals.description: Number of decimal places for the currency

supportedRegions.description: Region(s) this UMA Provider operates in

domain.description: Domain this VASP uses for UMA addresses

supportedCurrencies.description: List of currencies supported by this UMA Provider

lei.description: Legal Entity Identifier for the UMA Provider

allowListStatus.description: Whether this UMA Provider is on your allow list
